text:
alexa: Heads-up  I started a small PR to normalize the quickstart notebooks and migration guide for v1 -> v2. Noticed the Jupyter examples still import `redwood_v1` helper and the boto-style curl samples are out of date. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/962 :mag:
raj: nice catch. are we replacing v1 docs entirely or keeping a thin compatibility section? some partners still call the shim.
maddy: prefer keeping a short compatibility note but make the notebook cells runnable by default (v2 canonical). users expect copy-paste that works in a fresh env.
tom: agree. also the python notebook had an outdated `response_handler` utility name. it breaks nbconvert tests.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] notebook-tests failed on notebooks/quickstart.ipynb: cell 4 ImportError: cannot import name 'response_handler' from 'redwood'
alexa: thanks bot. plan: (1) convert notebooks to v2 API calls, (2) add a collapsible cell labeled "v1 compatibility" with a mapping and tiny wrapper that glues the old helper to v2, (3) fix curl & HTTP header examples.
raj: can we add runnable Go snippet as a bonus? a lot of quickstarts link to repos that expect it. minimal idiomatic example is enough.
maddy: i'll rewrite the python cells and add a short compatibility wrapper `def invoke_v1_compat(client, **kwargs):` that calls the v2 client under the hood. keep it clearly marked.
tom: i'll do the curl sweep and update the shell examples. show both non-streamed and streamed forms and mention Content-Type + Authorization headers. also add a small note about chunk framing.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] queued notebook lint for branch notebook-v2-sweep. ETA ~10m.
product-cmds: product wants a one-liner in the deprecation blurb: "Docs and quickstarts now show v2 patterns; v1 shim supported through 2025-12-31." please add to the changelog.
raj: i'll add a tiny Go code cell; use the Responses.Create pattern and show context + streaming via goroutines. minimal, ~6 lines.
alexa: action items: (A) Maddy: python notebook + compatibility wrapper + update tests; (B) Tom: curl and shell examples + framing note; (C) Raj: Go cell + small README update; (D) Alexa: update deprecation blurb in docs/changelog.md and merge after green.
maddy: pushed changes for the notebook, kept the v1 wrapper small and explicit. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/962/files#diff-abc
maddy: snippet sample inserted in notebook:
```python
# v2 canonical
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-4o-mini", input="Hello")
print(resp.output_text)
# v1 compatibility wrapper
def invoke_v1_compat(client, model_id, input_text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model_id, input=input_text)
```
tom: curl replacements pushed. old style:
```bash
# old v1 curl
curl -H "X-Old-Auth: $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/invoke
```
new canonical:
```bash
# v2 curl
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
plus a short streaming note recommending SDK stream helpers for correct chunk handling.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] notebook-lint passed for PR 962. examples job queued.
raj: added a Go snippet cell, kept it minimal: `resp, _ := client.Responses.Create(ctx, ResponsesCreateParams{Model: "gpt-4o-mini", Input: "hi"})` with a comment about streaming handlers.
alexa: nice. one more ask: update embeddings quickstart to mention alias migration: `embed-legacy-512` -> `rwd-embed-512-v2` and point to /assets/alias_map_v2.json. tom, can you add that footnote?
tom: added the alias footnote and a direct link to the alias_map JSON. pushed.
product-cmds: draft for comms ready: "We consolidated docs examples to v2 canonical patterns; the v1 shim remains available until 2025-12-31. Quickstarts updated to be runnable." Please include that line in the changelog entry.
alexa: PR green, merging now. thanks everyone. :ship:
